messages:
chris: Hey team — can someone pick up bench + smoke for new model Deerhorn-7B (hf/deerhorn-7b-v1) for hosted onboarding? Need p50/p95 tail-latency, steady-state throughput, and memory/profile artifacts. Target SLOs: p95 < 120ms @ batch=1, 3000 tok/s steady. Please run int8 and fp16, with kv-cache warm vs cold. include tail-latency sweep (batch sizes 1,4,8) and a prefix reuse test. Link to model spec: https://models.internal/deerhorn-7b

laura: I'm on it, will run smoke now and schedule the profiling job on cedar. ETA ~30m. I'll run both quant configs and post logs + flamegraphs.

evan: quick heads up — Deerhorn uses rotary embeddings; we saw a 10-15% p95 hurt on earlier rotary models when kv cache misaligned. Add a run with prefix length=512 and check kv cache hits.

jyoti: smoke done — quick numbers (fp16, 1 token prompt, batch=1): p50 28ms, p95 110ms, tokens/sec 2.9k, GPU mem 10.2GB. int8 lightweight quant: p95 130ms (so slightly over SLO), tok/s 3.4k, mem 6.1GB. Uploading raw logs.

ken: pasted smoke logs + flamegraph link: https://bench.internal/runs/4589/flame

perf-bot: Summary for run 4589
- fp16 @ batch=1: p50 28ms, p95 110ms, 2.9k tok/s
- int8 @ batch=1: p50 26ms, p95 130ms, 3.4k tok/s
- Memory: fp16 10.2GB, int8 6.1GB
- KV cache warm reduced p95 by ~12% on long-prefix tests
Dashboard: https://bench.internal/deerhorn-7b/4589

laura: Follow-ups: I'll run a tail-latency sweep across batch sizes [1,4,8] and a prefix-reuse sweep (prefix 0,128,512,1024). I'll also capture kernel-level timelines (nvprof) for the int8 path.

chris: Great — when you publish the bench report, please tag @eng-runtime and add the 'onboard' label. Also add a short note about the rotary-kv caveat so product knows. If int8 remains over p95 SLO, add a fallback plan in runtime (route to fp16 for latency-sensitive routes).

laura: Will do. Creating PR to post results to the model catalog + onboarding checklist. I'll include recommended runtime routing policy snippet:
```
route_policies:
  - name: deerhorn-low-latency
    match: latency_sensitive=true
    prefer: fp16
    fallback: int8
```

jyoti: small QA note — the smoke run used sequence_length=256. For fairness, also run with seq=1024 for convo-style prompts.

laura: good catch — scheduling seq=1024 runs now.

chris: thanks everyone — flag me if any regression persists. :thumbsup:
